evals.name: find-package-then-launch
evals.prompt: Open the Settings app on the running emulator.
expected_behavior: Finds the package if unsure with `drive apps settings` rather than guessing.
Launches by package name: `drive launch com.android.settings`.
Confirms it opened by switching to `/stream-droid:drive` and taking a screenshot / checking the foreground app — does not assume the launch worked.

evals.name: server-ensured-first
evals.prompt: Which app is in the foreground right now?
expected_behavior: Ensures a server is up with `stream-droid-server` if one isn't already running.
Runs `drive apps` and reports the current foreground app from the output.
Does NOT hand-start the server or read raw adb output directly.
